name: Warwick
notes: Eternal Hunger's bonus magic on-hit damage fires on every basic attack and is re-triggered by Jaws of the Beast's bite and by Infinite Duress's 1st/3rd/5th ticks (the ability apply on-hit effects); its healing is not modeled since only damage output matters in this fight.

Jaws of the Beast is cast on cooldown. Its ~0.2475 s bite delay is modeled as the engine's standard 0.25 s cast lockout and its cooldown is started right at the cast (the post-effect delay is negligible). The target-health-ratio term uses the champion formula (not the flat monster-capped variant) since the dummy counts as an enemy champion.

Blood Hunt is cast whenever off cooldown to guarantee its 8 s mark on the dummy, bypassing the health-threshold gate, since a short fight against a healthy dummy may never bring it below 50% health otherwise; the active itself deals no damage. Whenever Warwick lands basic-attack or ability damage on a target that is marked or below 50% max health, the bonus attack speed (doubled below 25% max health) is granted/refreshed for 1.25 s.
Primal Howl is cast on cooldown purely for the attack-reset its 1 s-delayed recast grants; its damage reduction and fear/slow have no effect on damage dealt.

Infinite Duress opens the fight (the engine's t=0 opening cast), channelling for 1.5 s (attacks are held during it) and dealing 6 magic damage ticks worth 2/9, 1/9, 2/9, 1/9, 2/9, 1/9 of its total; only the 1st/3rd/5th ticks apply on-hit effects (triggering Eternal Hunger), while all 6 ticks count as ability damage for the Blood Hunt attack-speed check. Its cooldown starts on cast.
Mana is not modeled: none of Warwick's costs are large enough relative to his level-16 pool to bind inside a 15 s fight.
